topic: The Stanford prison experiment was not what you were taught
subject: history

sources.title: Teaching scientific thinking using recent archival revelations about the Stanford Prison Experiment
Rethinking the nature of cruelty: The role of identity leadership in the Stanford Prison Experiment.
Evaluating the Criticisms of the Stanford Prison Experiment

facts.claim: The experimenters directly encouraged the guards to adopt roles and act tough.
facts.quote: experimenters directly encouraged them to adopt roles and act tough in a manner consistent with tenets of identity leadership.

facts.claim: The guards received precise instructions regarding the treatment of the prisoners.
facts.quote: the fact that the guards received precise instructions regarding the treatment of the prisoners

facts.claim: The SPE drew on a prison experiment conducted by students in one of Zimbardo's classes 3 months earlier.
facts.quote: the extent to which the SPE drew on a prison experiment devised and conducted by students in one of Zimbardo's classes 3 months earlier

facts.claim: The participants were selected as the most stable mentally and least involved in antisocial behaviours.
facts.quote: The participants were selected as the most stable mentally and least involved in antisocial behaviours of those who had applied to take part.

facts.claim: The college student prisoners were not representative of prison populations in terms of ethnicity, educational attainment and socioeconomic status.
facts.quote: The college student prisoners were not representative of prison populations in terms of ethnicity, educational attainment and socioeconomic status.

research.angle: Archival evidence shows that the guards' behavior was not a spontaneous result of their roles but was directly encouraged and instructed by the experimenters.
research.verdict: The evidence indicates that the Stanford Prison Experiment was heavily influenced by external instructions and prior student work rather than being a purely organic demonstration of role conformity.
research.caveat: While the sources highlight significant flaws and coaching, they also note that the interpersonal power dynamics in the simulation successfully mimicked those of a real prison.
